downloading.heading: Update required
downloading.description: This link opens something your version of Postman doesn't have yet.

ready.heading: Update ready
ready.description: Restart Postman to finish updating. You'll pick up right where this link was taking you.
ready.reload_description: Reload Postman to finish updating. You'll pick up right where this link was taking you.

failed.heading: Couldn't download the update
failed.description: Something went wrong while updating. You can try again, or open this now on your current version. Parts of it may not work.
failed.description_blocked: Something went wrong while updating. Try again, or come back to this link once Postman has updated.

unavailable.heading: No update available
unavailable.description: This link needs a newer version of Postman than is currently available. You can open it now, but parts of it may not work.
unavailable.description_blocked: This link needs a newer version of Postman than is currently available. Come back to it once an update is out.

managed.heading: Update required
managed.description: This link needs a newer version of Postman, and updates on this installation are managed by your administrator. Ask them to update Postman to open it.
managed.description_with_version: This link needs Postman {minCompatVersion} or later, and updates on this installation are managed by your administrator. Ask them to update Postman to open it.
